worked_solution:
Isolating the exponential term, we find

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{3}{5}\cdot {3}^{1-5x}+6 & >0 \\ \frac{3}{5}\cdot {3}^{1-5x} & >-6 \\ {3}^{1-5x} & >-10.\end{aligned}
$$

Because a power of a positive number is always greater than $0,$ we must have

$$
{3}^{1-5x}>0
$$

for all values of $x.$

Therefore, the inequality ${3}^{1-5x}>-10$ is satisfied for all real values of $x.$
